title: scan-config.yaml
description: Schema for the multi-language scan->fix platform config. Validated by the validate-scan-config hook; the reusable workflows do not validate a consumer's config. Keys marked deprecated are still accepted so existing configs validate.
comment-additionalProperties: false at the root catches typos like 'fx_loop' that would silently leave the fix-loop disabled. All known top-level keys are declared below.

local_hooks_enabled.description: Root-level local scanner switch. For pre-push scanning, used only when global.local_hooks_enabled is absent; change the global setting when both are present. Staged configuration validation still runs (CI + fix-loop unaffected).
When false, skip all local pre-commit/pre-push hooks (CI + fix-loop unaffected).

results_dir.description: Ignored: nothing reads it. Hooks write to .scanning/.

blocking_severities.description: Ignored: nothing reads it. Each hook and workflow sets its own threshold.

performance.description: Ignored: nothing reads it. No hook enforces a time limit.

languages.description: Languages. terraform, csharp, typescript and sql have scanners; any other name is accepted and has none.

sarif_upload.description: Ignored: nothing reads it. Use the upload-sarif workflow input.

category_prefix.description: Prefix prepended to each tool's SARIF category so uploads stay distinct (post-2025-07 GitHub rule).

fail_on.description: Ignored: nothing reads it. Use the workflow inputs.

required_checks.description: Informational list of check names. No hook or workflow reads it.

max_duration_days.description: Ignored: nothing reads it. Use settings.max_expiry_days in the registry.

require_approval.description: Ignored: nothing reads it. Use settings.require_security_approval in the registry.

enabled.description: Selects hosted Semgrep languages (csharp, typescript) and the C# on-demand scan, and tells setup verification what to check. A non-empty languages input on the calling workflow overrides it for hosted Semgrep. Does not switch local hooks on or off: the hook manifest and file types decide those.

file_patterns.description: Ignored: nothing reads it. Each hook matches its own file types.

build.description: Per-project build settings. Solves the dotnet-format path bug by config (never hardcoded).

working_dir.description: Directory to run the build/format tool from.

tools.description: Ignored: nothing reads it. Change the hook manifest or the workflow inputs.

version.description: Ignored: nothing reads it. CI uses the scanner versions pinned in the auto-code-scanning release; local hooks run whatever is on PATH. Still accepted so existing configs validate.

fix_loop.description: LAYER B agentic fix loop. Optional; off by default.

label.description: Ignored: nothing uses it. The workflow copies it to an output that no job consumes; the caller workflow owns the opt-in label.

human_review_label.description: Label applied when the loop stops (cap/gate/failure).

allowlist_paths.description: ONLY these path prefixes may be auto-fixed (allowlist, not denylist).

gated_paths.description: Security-sensitive substrings that are never auto-fixed.

claude_code_action_ref.description: Mirror of the SHA-pinned claude-code-action ref in the reusable workflow. Still required when enabled, but not read at run time.

build_verify_cmd.description: Authoritative re-verify command, run on the patched code by the verify job, which holds no secrets (e.g. 'dotnet build api/App.slnx'). '' = path gate and secret scan only.

required_secrets.description: Ignored: nothing reads it. Setup checks the supported secret names directly.
